== Overview ==

'''FriendsProtocol''' is the stock Rendez-Vous friends system. It provides a way for players to add each other as friends, block each other, and manage the resulting relationships.

Even though this protocol is implemented on Nintendo's game servers, it is never actually used. Instead Nintendo implemented their own friends services, [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceProtocol|NintendoFriendPresenceProtocol]] (3DS) and [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceV2Protocol|NintendoFriendPresenceV2Protocol]] (Wii U).

=== AddFriend ===

Sends a friend request to a player by their [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]].

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] || uiPlayer || [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the player to add
|-
| [[#RelationshipDetails]] || uiDetails || Unknown
|-
| [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#String|String]] || strMessage || Message sent along with the friend request
|}

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| Boolean || %retval% || Whether or not the friend request was created
|}

{| class="wikitable"

| Boolean || %retval% || Whether or not the relationship was cleared

=== GetList ===

Returns the [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PIDs]] of every player the caller has a given relationship with.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[#RelationshipType]] || byRelationship || The type of relationship to filter by
|-
| Boolean || bReversed || If <code>true</code>, flip the direction of the relationship check. For example, this changes the meaning of the <code>Pending</code> to filter between outgoing/incoming friend requests.
|}

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#List|List]]&lt;[[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]]&gt; || lstFriendsList || [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PIDs]] of the matching players
|}

=== GetDetailedList ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[#RelationshipType]] || byRelationship || The type of relationship to filter by
|-
| Boolean || bReversed || If <code>true</code>, flip the direction of the relationship check. For example, this changes the meaning of the <code>Pending</code> to filter between outgoing/incoming friend requests.
|}

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#List|List]]&lt;[[#FriendData]]&gt; || lstFriendsList || Details of the matching players
|}

== Classes ==

=== FriendData ===

Details about a player the caller has a relationship with.

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] || m_pid || [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the player
|-
| [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#String|String]] || m_strName || Game server account username of the player
|-
| [[#RelationshipType]] || m_byRelationship || The relationship between the player and the caller
|-
| [[#RelationshipDetails]] || m_uiDetails || Unknown
|-
| [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#String|String]] || m_strStatus || Unknown. The players status message? There doesn't seem to be any method to update this this, however. [https://github.com/michal-kapala/acb-rdv/blob/227ca6ac2b1da42c8e9857312f92d2ea5ac0cda5/QuazalWV/RMC/Services/FriendsService/Response/RMCPacketResponseFriendsService_GetDetailedList.cs#L36 <code>acb-rdv</code> always sets this to "Online"]
|}

=== RelationshipData ===

Details about a single relationship.

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] || m_pid || [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the other player in the relationship
|-
| [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#String|String]] || m_strName || Game server account username of the other player
|-
| [[#RelationshipType]] || m_byRelationship || The type of the relationship
|-
| [[#RelationshipDetails]] || m_uiDetails || Unknown
|-
| UInt8 || m_byStatus || 1 = online, 0 = offline
|}

== Enums ==

=== RelationshipType ===

Determines the kind of relationship between two players.

<pre>
enum RelationshipType : uint8_t {
  ...
};
</pre>

{| class="wikitable"
! Value !! Name !! Description
|-
| 1 || <code>Friend</code> || The players are friends
|-
| 2 || <code>Pending</code> || A friend request has been sent, but has not yet been accepted or declined
|-
| 3 || <code>Blocked</code> || One of the players has blocked the other
|}

== Flags ==

=== RelationshipDetails ===

<pre>
enum RelationshipDetails : uint32_t {
  ...
};
</pre>

Every relationship carries a set of "details", set when the relationship is created and changed afterwards with [[#UpdateDetails]]. The values of these details are not currently known. Game-specific? Assumed flags, maybe enum.
